text:
I haven't made any edits, because I can't write this change without seeing `app/src/survey.ts`. A SEARCH block has to match the file exactly, and I only know the file's path. I don't know how `outcomeOf` is written, what its rules about major findings are, or how findings, minors, waivers and advisories are represented. Any SEARCH text I wrote would be a guess and would probably be refused. Replacing the whole file would risk deleting the rest of your code.

Please paste the contents of `src/survey.ts`, or at least `outcomeOf` along with the types and helpers it uses. With that I can make the change:

- Count minor findings that aren't waived, leaving out advisories.
- Add one extra major finding when that count is five or more, and never more than one.
- Apply that extra major finding in every rule in `outcomeOf` that uses the major count, such as the thresholds for conditional and fail.

I'll also need to know whether "waived" is a flag on the finding or something else, since that decides how I filter.
